Saturn is currently roaming your 10th House, casting a square to your ruling planet Venus in your 2nd House, demanding you tighten truly financial discipline. Meanwhile, Mercury weaves a sextile to Neptune in your 5th House, sparking creative inspiration in love matters.

Your love life receives a boost as Mercury’s sextile to Neptune awakens romance, drawing single Taurus toward a charming artist, while Bulls must watch for misunderstandings born of wishful thinking.

In your 10th House, Saturn's square to Venus compels you to renegotiate a contract, turning a financial headache into a long‑term gain.

Avoid signing any major agreements under the influence of the Venus‑Saturn tension, or you'll face a setback.

Follow for tomorrow's reading to stay ahead of the celestial currents today, as an Earth sign you crave stability.
